hypothesis: Firms that rely less on external financing may have stronger internal cash generation and lower financing fragility. A low trailing-four-quarter net financing cash flow scaled by total assets may therefore improve defensive quality and recent-year outcomes when combined with quality value and cash quality.

factor.formula: negative trailing-four-quarter net financing cash flow divided by latest total assets; higher is better (less external financing)
factor.quarterly_cash_flow: de-cumulated from year-to-date net financing cash flow; Q1 uses the reported cumulative value and later quarters subtract the immediately preceding quarter
factor.effective_date: maximum statutory disclosure deadline of the four quarters plus four calendar days; no signal before that date
factor.point_in_time: statutory-deadline fallback; local 2021Q1-2026Q2 financial snapshots; no 2018-2020 restated data used

control_strategy.purpose: Matched universe, factor availability filter, and execution; net financing is not a score component.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.excluded_early_sample: 2018-2020 is excluded because the available 2017-2020 financial cache lacks reliable first-disclosure dates and would mix restated values into the signal.

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The four-quarter window, statutory-deadline fallback, direction, score weights, stock count, holding period, and stop loss are frozen before results; no post-result relaxation is allowed.
known_limitations: The local financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because the provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
Restatement risk remains and is not fully eliminated. The 2018-2020 R83 cross-sections are deliberately not used in the decision sample.
Net financing cash flow includes both debt and equity financing and is therefore broader than the existing equity-supply factor.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
